title.quote: Mind the GAP! The Challenges of Scale in Pixel-based Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: Title as given at the top of the paper.
title.value: Mind the GAP! The Challenges of Scale in Pixel-based Deep Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: The paper investigates why scaling pixel-based deep RL networks degrades performance, identifying the encoder-to-dense-layer connection ('bottleneck') as the cause, and proposes Global Average Pooling (GAP) as a simple alternative to SoftMoE and sparse-training approaches. Experiments use Rainbow on ALE and Procgen, DER/DrQ on Atari100K, and SAC on DMC.

type.quote: Justification: The paper does not include theoretical results.
type.justification: The paper runs extensive RL experiments and analyses; it states it includes no theoretical results.
